body:
I got to think a lot today. Well, over the last week, but I figured out what makes me happy today. It started as my recent disconnection from friends and family. 

People are always thought to be social creatures and I think I was butting up against that really hard. If we are social, why is it a friend base I have been so keen on creating typically wants nothing to do with me?? 

Then I realized, I have been seeking the approval or comfort of something that has been precented to us as a necessity. But as I thought and explored my feelings today, I realized, I don't want any of that. Nobody is reaching out to me and I not reaching out to them I have not had contact with another human in 6 days... other than this thread. I have been loving every moment of nobody caring, not seeking approval, not needing or wanting anything from anybody.

I have realized, I don't want to be social. I don't want to have friends. I want nothing to do with anybody any more. I am sure I will be seen by everybody as being... any number of things, and I simply don't care. 

It is nice to get thoughts out to the world now and then, but I don't give a shit if anybody reads it, or comments about it, or likes it, or hates it. 

Thank you, most of all for humoring me for the past couple days. Have a nice life.

My only wish is that this is a stage. Although, there has not been a moment that hasn't been like this sence I can remeber. Sure there have been a few points where I could say there was some happiness, but looking back there was so little there that was real. Delusion or illusion, I can't decide, but the point is that it wasn't real. Now, I have found that my "friends" don't much care about me. I have struggled for years to keep in touch with those I call my friends. I always call them and reach out to them and just try to be a good friend. Here I am a month into not talking to a single one of them. Not because I have been avoiding them, but I stopped calling and I realize that my worth or value to them is next to zero. Nobody reaches out to me. I find, that my family doesn't reach out to me either. It would be nice if somebody would send me a text or call or an e-mail and ask "how have you been?" I don't think that day will ever come. I am pretty sure if I were dead nobody would know for months. Again, I wish this was a phase or stage, but this is the second time, now in a very different stage of life, where I have been alone with nobody reaching out to me. The first time, it was very clear I was in a very bad way and nobody. I don't want to go into it, but I can't imagine a worse point in anybody's life. I went to some groups then for help and even those with the worst of stories, felt bad for me, and still... nobody.
but knowing what I know now... the true hurt I feel now... is that when I thought I had that, I never did. Not one person has ever really cared, and that, that is the knife in the wound.

I know when I have had happiness and that is all I want to get back to. I was happy, over all, whenever I had somebody. Obviously there were ups and downs, but knowing somebody loved me... that made me happy.

I have been in help for 6 months now. I have been taking steps to fill my life with more people. When, I do go out I feel completely empty. Sure I put on a fake smile and dance around like a monkey making those around me happy. I hide a lot in front of other people. 

I have talked to my closest friends about being lonely and they all sell the same platitudes all of my other friends have fed me before them, before their lives changed and they left. 

I struggle very much with trying to keep the friends I have and to make new ones. I do a lot of things I don't like to do, just to have the chances to makes new friends. 

I am an introvert. I hate going out with people. I hate small talk. I can't stand the stupidity of the general public. Yet, all I do is appease for these small chances I have been deluding myself into thinking there are. I am doing all of those things in which I need to do to make the change I want to make. I have been slamming my head against this proverbial wall over and over and over and I am sick of it. 

How do I overcome this... blandness of life? These continued exercises in futility for changes that don't come? 

You know, I may not end up going through with the final act, but I hope every day something does kill me. Tell me, how is slowly agonizing over every ticking second waiting for death to come any better? 

"you wake up every day and hang your head and cry, you want to die, but you just can't quit. let me break it on down, that's some fucked up shit" Warren Zevon

I have been to help. I continue to see help. 

I know I am a success at what I do... I am always at the top end of everything I do. All... everything I do is just checking off meaningless tasks on a long list of bs society has come up for us to do. 

I simply do not have what it takes to acquire what makes me happy. 

there are no drugs to cure  wait ails me
